author: Creekside Taphouse
text: WINTER CREW WANTED 🍁 We're staffing up for the season at Creekside. Need 2 line cooks (full-time, $24/hr) and 1 bartender (part-time, $19/hr + tips). Season pass provided, staff meals on shift. Start date is flexible from mid-November. Email hiring@creeksidetaphouse.ca with a quick intro — no formal CV needed.

author: Dana K
text: Looking for a housekeeping supervisor to start ASAP. Staff accommodation available in Function Junction, shared apartment. Must have 2+ seasons experience and be able to work weekends. DM me for details, I'm not checking email much.

author: Marcus Bell
text: Hey all — I'm arriving in Banff Nov 10 with an approved IEC visa and looking for front desk or housekeeping work for the season. 3 seasons in hospitality in the UK, references available. Happy to take anything to start. Cheers!

group: Niseko Winter Work / ニセコ 冬 求人
author: 白樺ロッジ
text: 【スタッフ募集】ニセコひらふのロッジでフロントスタッフを募集しています。期間は12月中旬から3月末まで。時給1,400円、寮あり（相部屋）、リフト券支給。英語と日本語ができる方歓迎。ワーキングホリデービザの方も歓迎します。詳しくは info@shirakaba-lodge.jp までご連絡ください。

group: Park City / Deer Valley Seasonal Staff
author: Summit Rentals
text: Hiring ski technicians for the 26/27 season. J-1 and H-2B applicants welcome, we sponsor. Pay DOE, $20-26/hr depending on experience. Housing is NOT provided but we can point you to options. Season runs late Nov through early April. Apply at summitrentals.com/careers

author: Jo Ellis
text: Selling a pair of Salomon QST 106s, 181cm, mounted for a 27.5 boot. Used two seasons, bases are in good shape. $320 or trade for a decent touring setup. Pickup in Whistler Village.

author: Powder House Hakuba
text: Staff wanted for the coming winter — we need a chef de partie, two housekeepers and a driver. Accommodation and meals included, lift pass for the Hakuba Valley. Working holiday visa holders very welcome. Season is December to March. Message us on Instagram @powderhousehakuba or find us on FB.
